description.value: Al-Madina General Store is a convenience shop located in downtown Vancouver on West Pender Street. It is notable for accepting Bitcoin, Lightning Network, and on-chain cryptocurrency payments, making it unusual among neighbourhood stores. Beyond its location in a cycling-accessible part of the city, no further details about its offerings for touring cyclists can be confirmed from available sources.
